versions.changelog:
Initial release of Session Daily Backup - Obsidian:

- Automates daily backup of OpenClaw session conversations to an Obsidian Vault at 2:00 AM.
- Supports incremental backup, merging multiple sessions into a single daily file.
- Uses Obsidian callout format with color-coding for conversation distinction.
- Monitors token usage with 80%/90% thresholds and sends QQ warnings.
- Provides session/token statistics and flexible manual/automatic backup scripts.
- Requires `jq`, bash, and compatible OpenClaw session files (JSONL format).
